Credits and open-source licences

PIGEON is created and directed by The Shrimp Blimp, and is free and open source under GPL-3.0-only.

Built on Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (@kurogedelic) and Hügelton Instruments. Its platform, sampler foundation, USB transport, package format, and update loader make PIGEON possible.

Installer compatibility safeguards, recovery boot stub, and commit-last update design adapted from ChoralRoot FM-1 by Quixotic7 and the ChoralRoot FM-1 contributors (GPL-3.0-only). PIGEON adapts the recovery layout to preserve its sample storage.

Logo by Dendy0097 · Font by Disastrid: Little Character (SIL OFL 1.1). MP3 decoding: libmad (GPL-2.0-or-later); browser MP3 encoding: lamejs/LAME (LGPL-3.0). Firmware packages include three JieLi AC79 SDK files (Apache-2.0).

M-VAVE and FM-1 are trademarks of their respective owners. PIGEON is an independent project.
